title: Sets lineage from Adam to Noah
description: The genealogy from Adam through Seth, Enosh, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah and Lamech to Noah and his sons. Enoch walked with God, and God took him away.

versions.title: Seth's lineage
versions.description: The genealogy from Adam through Seth to Noah, including Enoch who walked with God.
